requirements.summary: Create a responsive aura&adorn marketing Home page with brand headline, featured category sections, and clear navigation to categories.
acceptanceCriteria: The site displays the brand name "aura&adorn" prominently on the Home page and header
The Home page includes sections for Fashion, Jewelry, and Luxury products
Layout is usable on mobile and desktop (no horizontal scroll, readable typography)

file_operations.description: Create the root app shell with a header, footer, and page routing (Home + category navigation entry points) to support a responsive marketing site for "aura&adorn".
Create a responsive header that displays the "aura&adorn" brand name prominently and provides navigation links to Fashion, Jewelry, and Luxury category pages.
Implement the Home page hero headline and featured sections for Fashion, Jewelry, and Luxury with clear calls-to-action linking into their category pages.
Create a shared footer used across the site to provide consistent navigation affordances (including a link to the Affiliate Disclosure page).

requirements.summary: Implement affiliate browsing UX with category listing pages (Fashion/Jewelry/Luxury) showing product cards and a product details view with an outbound affiliate link opening in a new tab.
acceptanceCriteria: Each category page shows a list/grid of products with images and titles
Each product has a details view (or expanded view) with a prominent "Shop" / "View Offer"-style outbound link
Outbound affiliate links open in a new browser tab

file_operations.description: Create a reusable category listing page that renders a responsive grid/list of product cards for the selected category (Fashion/Jewelry/Luxury), including image, name, short description, and optional price/price range.
Create a product details view that displays full product information and includes a prominent outbound affiliate button/link configured to open in a new browser tab with safe link attributes.
Create a product card component used in category listings to show product image, title, and key metadata, and link to the product details view.
Add React Query hooks for fetching and caching products from the backend interface (list products and filter by category on the client) and fetching a single product for the details view.
Wire new routes for category listing pages (Fashion/Jewelry/Luxury) and the product details view so they are reachable via navigation and direct links.
Use shadcn-ui components for consistent cards/buttons/typography styling across listings and product details. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add an admin-only UI for managing affiliate products (create/edit/delete) gated by Internet Identity authentication and admin authorization, while keeping public browsing accessible.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin page is not accessible unless the user is authenticated via Internet Identity
Admin can create, edit, and delete products and see changes reflected in category listings
Non-authenticated users can browse products but cannot access admin controls

file_operations.description: Create an admin-only page that allows managing affiliate products (create/edit/delete) via backend calls and shows immediate UI refresh via React Query cache invalidation. Use shadcn-ui form controls and dialogs as appropriate. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement a route guard wrapper that requires Internet Identity authentication and checks admin authorization (via backend role helpers) before rendering admin content; otherwise render an access denied experience. Use the authorization component’s frontend guidance for role-based access patterns. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a login/logout button using the existing Internet Identity hook, clearing cached queries on logout to prevent stale admin data exposure. Use the authorization component’s frontend guidance for login/logout UX. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create an access denied screen for unauthorized users attempting to access admin routes, with a clear path to login and return to public browsing.
Add React Query mutation hooks for create/update/delete product operations, including success handlers that invalidate product list queries so category pages reflect changes.
Add a minimal Admin navigation entry (only visible to authenticated admins) and include the LoginButton in the header so admins can access management tools without impacting public browsing.
Register and wire the admin route into the router and wrap it with the AdminRouteGuard so it is unreachable without Internet Identity auth + admin authorization.

requirements.summary: Add an Affiliate Disclosure page and a short affiliate disclosure snippet in the footer with English-only user-facing text.
acceptanceCriteria: A dedicated "Affiliate Disclosure" page exists and is reachable from the footer
Footer contains a short affiliate disclosure snippet in English

file_operations.description: Create a dedicated Affiliate Disclosure page with clear English language describing affiliate relationships and commission disclosures.
Add a short English affiliate disclosure snippet and a footer link that navigates to the Affiliate Disclosure page.
Wire the Affiliate Disclosure page route and ensure it is reachable from the footer across the site.

requirements.summary: Apply a coherent luxury/fashion visual theme (neutral tones; not blue/purple) across Home, category pages, product views, and admin pages with consistent typography and spacing.
acceptanceCriteria: A consistent palette and typography system is used across all pages
The design reads as luxury/fashion oriented (e.g., neutral tones, refined contrast, clean layout)
No pages fall back to unstyled default HTML appearance

file_operations.description: Adjust Tailwind CSS variables and base styles to establish a neutral luxury palette (avoiding blue/purple), refined contrast, and consistent typography/spacing defaults applied site-wide.
Extend theme tokens (colors/typography/spacing as needed) to support a cohesive luxury styling system used by shared components and pages.
Apply consistent luxury styling (layout, typography, spacing) and ensure the header remains responsive and readable on mobile and desktop.
Apply consistent luxury styling and ensure footer readability and layout consistency across pages.
Ensure Home hero and featured sections follow the established luxury theme and do not display unstyled default HTML elements.
Ensure category listings (grid/cards) follow the established luxury theme and remain responsive without horizontal scrolling.
Ensure product details typography, spacing, and call-to-action styling match the luxury theme.
Ensure admin management UI uses the same theme system and does not fall back to unstyled defaults.
Use shadcn-ui components consistently to avoid unstyled HTML controls and to maintain cohesive UI behavior and visuals. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add and render generated brand images as static assets and use them in the header/hero and favicon/app icon as appropriate.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the UI
Brand mark appears in the header and/or Home hero area
An app icon/favicon is set using generated assets

file_operations.description: Add the generated aura&adorn wordmark image asset as a static public file for use in the header and/or hero.
Add the generated aura&adorn monogram image asset as a static public file for use as favicon/app icon.
Add the generated neutral hero background image asset as a static public file for use in the Home hero section.
Reference frontend/public/assets/generated/aura-adorn-monogram.dim_512x512.png as the favicon/app icon via appropriate head tags.
Render the brand mark using frontend/public/assets/generated/aura-adorn-wordmark.dim_1200x300.png (and/or monogram) in the header alongside the brand name.

Use frontend/public/assets/generated/aura-adorn-hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png in the hero section and display the wordmark (frontend/public/assets/generated/aura-adorn-wordmark.dim_1200x300.png) as part of the brand headline area.
